date_scope_check.qualification:
REC50-R41-003-P1: The official notice orders a 2–23 November 2020 window. Neither final-day boundary nor later fuel exception establishes general freight reopening. The November 23 observed fuel passage conflicts with a November 24 scheduled restart; petroleum access is periodic and limited.

Later formal permissions: NARTAM’s 18 February 2021 update permits fodder imports at Tsagaannuur from February 23. Its 18 May update reports that, from May 10, Tsagaannuur–Tashanta could handle all types of goods during the second and fourth weeks of each month. These are commodity/schedule relaxations, not proof of daily unrestricted freight, a first observed truck, or continuous closure since November. The November 23 observed fuel entry and November 24 scheduled restart remain distinct.
